charts.title: Supply and demand quadrants
charts.notes: Both axes are ranks, not percentages of postings. Duplicate display names retain separate source records. No jitter.

charts.title: Alignment mix across majors
charts.notes: 100% stacked shares, not counts of students.

charts.title: Largest market gaps
charts.notes: Top 12 rows, retaining source identity; zero-based bar axis.

charts.title: Market gaps by major
charts.notes: Diverging colors share the fixed −1 to +1 rank-gap scale.

charts.title: Archetype cluster selection
charts.notes: Shared score scale; points represent tried k values, not a learning curve.

charts.title: Pooled archetype sizes and promotion rates
charts.notes: Point rates have no invented intervals. Full labels and counts remain in plotting data.

charts.title: Archetype major composition
charts.notes: Counts computed from saved pooled assignments, avoiding rounding in the major_mix display field.

charts.title: Archetype industry mix
charts.notes: Shared 0–100% sequential color scale; absent combinations have zero count.

charts.title: Archetype geographic concentration
charts.notes: Fixed LQ color limits 0.5–1.5, midpoint 1; hub outlines are descriptive, not significance marks.

charts.title: Observed role transition probabilities
charts.notes: Zero destinations are inferred only for observed origin rows. No unobserved Functional Lead origin row is manufactured.

charts.title: Most common title paths
charts.notes: Two highest-count edges per major, not two highest conditional probabilities. Full denominators are in source/plotting data.

charts.title: Entry-role promotion comparison
charts.notes: Classification flags use existing unadjusted tests. No invented uncertainty on promotion-rate points.

charts.title: Frequent title sequences
charts.notes: One most-supported closed pattern per major; support_pct source values are fractions, formatted as percentages.

charts.title: Absorbing-chain extrapolation
charts.notes: Dashed paths are scenario projections, not forecasts validated by additional observations. No uncertainty is supplied.

charts.title: Salary model cross-validation
charts.notes: Symmetric bars are SD across folds for R² only. Both bar axes begin at zero.

charts.title: Skill salary premiums with robust intervals
charts.notes: Dollar CI endpoints = (exp(saved log-coefficient CI) − 1) × mean starting salary. Intervals are pointwise, not FDR-adjusted.

charts.title: Salary control estimates
charts.notes: References inferred from observed levels absent from model coefficient table; source alumni fingerprint recorded in run manifest.

charts.title: TreeSHAP feature importance
charts.notes: Magnitude is unsigned and does not imply a positive effect. Saved attribution values, not a reconstructed SHAP beeswarm.

charts.title: Largest TreeSHAP interactions
charts.notes: Uses the saved upper-triangle entry scale; not doubled into a joint contribution.

charts.title: Requested skill-pair estimability
charts.notes: All-zero estimates retain a symmetric ±$1 display window. Missing pair estimates are text only, never fabricated zeros.
